description: This Java class 'GZIPRequestStream' extends 'ServletInputStream' to provide a wrapper around an input stream that handles GZIP-compressed data within a web filter context, enabling decompression of incoming HTTP request streams.

classes.name: GZIPRequestStream
classes.description: A custom ServletInputStream that wraps a GZIPInputStream to decompress GZIP data from an HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: GZIPRequestStream
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GZIPInputStream with the request's input stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads bytes into buffer or returns a single byte, delegating to the underlying GZIPInputStream.

methods.name: isFinished
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream is finished; not supported, throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Checks if the stream is ready; not supported, throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: setReadListener
methods.description: Sets a ReadListener for asynchronous operation; not supported, throws UnsupportedOperationException.
